title: 2.3.17 Group Cases: Vowel or Consonant
description: Write a switch with grouped cases that prints Vowel for a, e, i, o, u and Consonant for anything else. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a variable to switch on
steps.instructions: Create a variable called letter and assign it a single lowercase letter, for example 'e'.

steps.title: Write grouped cases for the vowels
steps.instructions: Write a switch on letter. Stack case labels for 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' with no code between them, so all five fall into one block that prints Vowel. Add a default that prints Consonant. Use grouped cases, not ||.

requirements.title: 'a' and 'e' cases grouped
requirements.description: case 'a' is stacked directly above case 'e' with no code between them

requirements.title: 'u' case reaches the shared block
requirements.description: case 'u' is grouped in among the vowel cases
